Wonderful
Dec 2024 • Couples
My partner and I popped in for drinks and glad we did. 
We received a warm welcome and 'Thanh', apologies if spelling the name incorrectly. He was the one in the black shirt and Santa hat) looked after us most of the afternoon. It was a shame we missed him when we left. 
We tried many different beers and wine. All were excellent and high quality. We especially liked the cherry beer.
We decided to eat there also. As vegetarians Thanh was very helpful. All the food was delicious and presented beautifully. We wish we found this place sooner. We will be sure to recommend to everyone on the travel blog! Thank you for a wonderful experience.

Top Meal in Vietnam-WOWSA
Jan 2024 • Family
Would it be sacrilege if I say this was our favorite meal in Vietnam? We loved all of the food but this meal was glorious.

The Chicken liver pate was exceptional. Smooth & nutty & buttery. Best of the meal!!! The pumpkin chutney added to the flavor in such a big way.

Fries...ya gotta get the fries. They were hot and crispy and the perfect beer sidekick.

I had the Waterzooi. A few years ago, I fell in love with it in Ghent. The mildest stew with the most fragrant broth. It did not disappoint.

Great burger. 

I didnt write down the beers we tried and now I cannot remember...but nothing disappointed.

Such a great experience!!

Service was top shelf!!! 

Top recommendation.
